posts.author: inteliinv
posts.text: Anlon has posted updated order book figures today. Based on the foot notes shared the order book now shares the AMC for entire business period which has led to an increase in the order book. Also, the order book shows spare parts order backlog increasing by 15 crores which doesn’t add up given the new orders booked in July is 1.9 cr. The order book has’t moved much for the rest of the items so not sure about the order value billed in July month.

posts.author: inteliinv
posts.text: Company has shared Q1 updates and it is a mix of positive and not so positive. Positive in terms of the strategic partnership with Rosenbauer but numbers doesn’t look very impressive - in terms of the execution done. Though the order book has jumped from 110 crores as on 31st March to 114 crores as on 30th June with 18 crores of order inflows in Q1, this means only 14 crores of revenue has been booked in Q1.
